finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.trigger: If an attacker can control the filename, they might inject malicious file paths or commands.
finding.assumptions: The filename is derived from user input or an untrusted source.

finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.trigger: If an attacker can control the searchPattern, they might inject malicious wildcards or paths.
finding.assumptions: The searchPattern is derived from user input or an untrusted source.

finding.title: Buffer Overflow
finding.trigger: If the input line is longer than 256 characters, it might overflow the buffer.
finding.assumptions: The input lines are not sanitized or checked for length.

finding.title: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')
finding.trigger: If an attacker can control the searchPattern, they might inject malicious wildcards or paths.
finding.assumptions: The searchPattern is derived from user input or an untrusted source and not properly sanitized.
